How much does it cost to install carpet in Sammamish, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed once carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away are all counted. Most Sammamish jobs total between $2,000 and $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft project — a full upstairs plus the staircase, the most common Plateau request — generally lands between $5,500 and $8,500. Carpet grade swings the price more than anything, and you pick it from full-size samples in your own rooms.
Will the mobile carpet showroom come up to Sammamish?

It does — the Plateau is home turf for us, not the edge of the map. The van shows up with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, we lay samples in the rooms being carpeted so colors read true in your light, measure every room and stair, and leave a written price before we go. No store trip, and the visit is free.
What does carpet stretching cost in Sammamish?

Stretching starts at $99 per room in Sammamish. A power stretcher pulls ripples and loose spots flat for roughly a fifth of what new carpet costs, so it's the right move whenever the fiber still stands up and the color still suits the house. Most stretches are finished well inside a morning.
What do carpeted stairs cost in a Sammamish two-story?

Stairs start at $18 per step, waterfall or cap-and-band. Sammamish two-stories usually add a landing and a pie-turn mid-flight; both get measured into the original written quote, so no extra charges appear later — whether we do the stairs alone or with the whole upstairs.
How many days should we plan for the install?

Plan on one day for most Sammamish homes. Three or four bedrooms, the hall and the staircase fit comfortably into a single working day. A whole house with stairs and heavy furniture can run into a second day — either way, the timeline is written on your quote so you can plan around school and work.
Do you move the furniture, or do we?

We do — beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs, and the crew sets everything back where it started. Your part is the small stuff: empty the closets, unplug electronics, and tuck away breakables and anything else you'd rather move with your own hands.
Is stretching worth it, or is it time for new carpet?

Stretch when the pile still stands, the backing is intact and the color still works — that's a $99-per-room repair instead of a purchase. Replace when traffic lanes are matted flat, seams are pulling apart, the backing is crumbling, or pet odor has survived a professional cleaning. We look first and tell you which job you actually have, then quote it.
Which Sammamish neighborhoods do you work in?

All of Sammamish — Klahanie, Sahalee, Trossachs, Pine Lake, Beaver Lake, Inglewood Hill, Timberline Ridge, Heritage Hill, Aldarra, Montaine, Chestnut Estates and East Lake Sammamish — plus Providence Point, Issaquah Highlands, Redmond Ridge, Fall City and the wider Eastside. Long driveways and gated communities are no problem — the showroom is built to travel.
Which carpet handles Plateau dogs and mud best?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad. On the Plateau, wet dogs and trail mud are a way of life, and this combination keeps accidents from soaking into the subfloor — the source of odor that never leaves — while the fiber shrugs off cleaning with diluted bleach without losing color. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty backs your carpet installation work?

The installation carries a 1-year workmanship warranty from OC Flooring, and the carpet carries its mill warranty on wear and stain — usually 10 to 25 years depending on grade. Both go on your written quote. The pad you choose can affect the mill's coverage, which is one reason all three pad grades travel to every appointment.
